messages.subject: Early review request: Video Rebirth BACH — access, commercial rights and affiliate details
messages.body:
Hi Fay,

I'm Tom Tran, founder of AI Video Picks (aivideopicks.com) — an affiliate blog and video channel covering AI video tools for creators and SMBs.

I'm writing because BACH 1.0 Pro's advance to #3 on the Artificial Analysis Image-to-Video leaderboard (announced September 16) is the strongest independent quality signal I've seen for a reference-guided multi-shot tool. I'd like to cover BACH early and honestly.

I'm requesting official documentation, review access, media rights, and affiliate programme details — specifically:

1. **Official Documentation:** Published commercial-use terms for video output generated by BACH. The TOS was not locatable on bach.art as of today — our readers and our own workflow require clear confirmation that outputs can be used in monetized YouTube videos and affiliate content. Also: API pricing (pricing page 404 today), AU/APAC routing for the api-gen-na endpoint, and BACH 1.0 Pro launch date.

2. **Review Access:** Complimentary bounded trial credits for 10–15 test runs (60–90 days). We plan to run a specific case study: three identical runs of Element2Video using a product reference image to test whether product identity is preserved in the first 10 seconds of output — our hard gate for affiliate content recommendations.

3. **Media Rights:** Permission to reproduce official screenshots, demo video clips, and press kit assets in monetized articles and YouTube videos, with appropriate disclosure.

4. **Affiliate Programme Details:** Signup URL, commission %, cookie duration, payout schedule, minimum, Australian eligibility, restricted keyword bidding rules. If no programme currently exists, whether one is planned.

5. **Factual Contact:** A technical contact who can answer questions about BACH before we publish.

Our commitments: Editorial independence is non-negotiable — we do not grant approval rights or guarantee positive coverage. We will fully disclose any complimentary access and affiliate relationships. Our conclusions come from evidence; we report limitations honestly.

Access does not guarantee positive coverage.

We are requesting official documentation, requesting complimentary bounded review access, requesting approved media rights, and requesting affiliate programme details as described above.

Thank you for building something worth reviewing.

Tom Tran
AI Video Picks
https://aivideopicks.com
contact@aivideopicks.com
